remarks: Commuter's Dream! Nestled in the heart of South Wilton, this charming ranch is just minutes from town, train stations, and major highways. The home features an updated kitchen with an oversized center island, cooktop, and wall oven, seamlessly opening into the dining room and living room, which is enhanced by a cozy fireplace and custom built-ins. With 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths, and hardwood floors throughout, this home provides comfort and style. The fully finished lower level is perfect for entertaining, complete with a built-in bar area, full bath, laundry, and ample space for a pool table or casual living area, adding an impressive 1,466 square feet of living space. A legal 1-bedroom apartment with a separate entrance provides up to $2,000 per month in rental income-totaling $24,000 annually, enough to cover taxes and expenses. This versatile space can also serve as an in-law suite, au pair suite, or a home office with its own entrance. If desired, it can be incorporated back into the main house, offering numerous options for the new owner. The property is flat, private, and bordered by conservation land, including direct access to the NRVT right from its backyard. This trail is also accessible from the beginning of the street, making it ideal for nature lovers. Additional features include brand new roof, central air system and CITY WATER, further enhancing this exceptional property. Don't miss out on this fabulous opportunity!
